title: Democrats Wanted Zero Tolerance for Misconduct. Then Came Virginia.

sentences.en: Democrats have adopted a policy of zero tolerance for misconduct, past or present, by members of their own party.
sentences.zh: 民主党人对本党成员无论过去还是现在的违纪行为采取了零容忍政策。

sentences.en: The growing political crisis in Virginia is testing that approach.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州日益严峻的政治危机正在考验这一方针。

sentences.en: It's
sentences.zh: 今天是

sentences.en: Friday, February 8th.
sentences.zh: 2月8日，星期五。

sentences.en: John is down on the front desk.
sentences.zh: 约翰在前台。

sentences.en: How am I being an assistant?
sentences.zh: 我怎么就像个助手了？

sentences.en: Hey there.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好。

sentences.en: I'm trying to reach a guest named Jonathan Martin in room 506.
sentences.zh: 我想找一位叫乔纳森·马丁的住客，他在506房间。

sentences.en: I'll connect you right now.
sentences.zh: 我马上为你转接。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Hey, guys.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计们。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你们好吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: I think we did find the right Marriott.
sentences.zh: 我想我们确实找到了正确的万豪酒店。

sentences.en: Okay, let's jump in.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们切入正题吧。

sentences.en: Jonathan Martin covers national politics for The Times.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·马丁为《时报》报道全国政治。

sentences.en: Jonathan, where does this story really start?
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，这个故事究竟是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: I think it has its roots in the Al Franken scandal.
sentences.zh: 我认为它的根源在于阿尔·弗兰肯丑闻。

sentences.en: A growing firestorm on Capitol Hill after Democratic Senator Al Franken is accused of forcibly kissing and groping a woman more than a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 在民主党参议员阿尔·弗兰肯被指控在十多年前强吻并对一名女性进行猥亵之后，国会山爆发了一场日益猛烈的风暴。

sentences.en: If you recall, it was the fall of 2017.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得的话，那是2017年的秋天。

sentences.en: Another woman is coming forward to make groping accusations against Minnesota Senator Democrat
sentences.zh: 又有一名女性站出来，指控明尼苏达州民主党参议员

sentences.en: Al Franken.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·弗兰肯对其实施猥亵。

sentences.en: An array of stories came out.
sentences.zh: 各种报道接踵而至。

sentences.en: And another woman has come forward accusing Senator Al Franken of groping her during a USO tour.
sentences.zh: 又有一名女性站出来，指控阿尔·弗兰肯参议员在劳军联合慰问团（USO）巡演期间对她进行猥亵。

sentences.en: She's the fifth woman to accuse the Minnesota Senator of inappropriate behavior.
sentences.zh: 她是第五位指控这位明尼苏达州参议员行为不端的女性。

sentences.en: And there were enough charges against him.
sentences.zh: 针对他的指控已经足够多了。

sentences.en: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, Claire McCaskill, Maisie Hirono, Maggie Hassan.
sentences.zh: 参议员克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德、克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔、广野庆子、玛吉·哈assan。

sentences.en: That finally...
sentences.zh: 最终……

sentences.en: Patty Murray, Kamala Harris, Tammy Baldwin, Bob Casey of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·默里、卡玛拉·哈里斯、塔米·鲍德温、宾夕法尼亚州的鲍勃·凯西。

sentences.en: Senate Democrats urged him to resign, led by Kirsten Gillibrand, now a candidate for president.
sentences.zh: 在现任总统候选人克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德的带领下，参议院民主党人敦促他辞职。

sentences.en: And keep in mind, this was the same time that in Alabama...
sentences.zh: 请记住，这与亚拉巴马州……

sentences.en: Alabama Senate candidate Roy Moore remains defiant at this point, denying sexual assault allegations and rejecting calls to drop out.
sentences.zh: 亚拉巴马州参议员候选人罗伊·摩尔此时依然态度强硬，否认性侵指控，并拒绝退选。

sentences.en: Roy Moore had been accused of sexual misconduct with a group of underage women when he was younger.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔年轻时曾被指控对一群未成年女性实施性行为不端。

sentences.en: And the Democrats were trying to pick up that seat.
sentences.zh: 而民主党人正试图赢得那个席位。

sentences.en: And they didn't want to give the Republicans any fodder to kind of dilute their attacks against Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 他们不想给共和党人提供任何口实，从而削弱他们对罗伊·摩尔的攻击。

sentences.en: Enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 够了就是够了。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a conversation we've been having for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们已经讨论了很长时间的一个话题。

sentences.en: We need to draw a line in the sand and say none of it is OK.
sentences.zh: 我们需要划清界限，声明这一切都是不可接受的。

sentences.en: None of it is acceptable.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是无法容忍的。

sentences.en: And we, as elected leaders, should absolutely be held to a higher standard, not a lower standard.
sentences.zh: 而且我们作为民选领袖，绝对应该受到更高标准的约束，而不是更低的标准。

sentences.en: And we should fundamentally be valuing women.
sentences.zh: 我们从根本上应该珍视女性。

sentences.en: And that is where this debate has to go.
sentences.zh: 这就是这场辩论必须走向的方向。

sentences.en: They want to position themselves on the high ground, morally and politically.
sentences.zh: 他们希望在道德和政治上占据道德高地。

sentences.en: And you take that and put it against the backdrop of an Alabama Senate race where, lo and behold,
sentences.zh: 结合亚拉巴马州的参议院选举背景，看吧，

sentences.en: Democrats now have an opportunity to win a seat that they hadn't had in decades.
sentences.zh: 民主党人现在有机会赢得一个他们几十年来从未拥有过的席位。

sentences.en: And they are acting in ways that are going to position themselves best for that.
sentences.zh: 他们的行为正在为自己争取最好的政治立场。

sentences.en: Serving in the United States Senate has been the great honor of my life.
sentences.zh: 在美国参议院任职是我一生中最大的荣誉。

sentences.en: And Al Franken was being accused of these things during that moment.
sentences.zh: 而阿尔·弗兰肯正是在那个时候被指控这些事情的。

sentences.en: And Democrats did not really hesitate.
sentences.zh: 民主党人其实并没有犹豫。

sentences.en: Today, I am announcing that in the coming weeks, I will be resigning as a member of the United States Senate.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布在未来几周内，我将辞去美国参议员职务。

sentences.en: So what does asking Senator Al Franken to resign represent about the strategy that the Democrats were forming in this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，要求阿尔·弗兰肯参议员辞职，反映了民主党人在当时正在形成的什么策略？

sentences.en: I think the strategy was we have to police our own ranks.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个策略就是我们必须纯洁我们自己的队伍。

sentences.en: And the sort of implication of that was in the Trump era, we have to have clean hands.
sentences.zh: 这其中隐含的意思是，在特朗普时代，我们的双手必须是干净的。

sentences.en: And if we're going to criticize the president, we have to have a zero tolerance policy in our own ranks.
sentences.zh: 如果我们打算批评总统，我们就必须在自己队伍内部实行零容忍政策。

sentences.en: We cannot accept misconduct that is going to let the Republicans sort of muddy the waters politically, if you will, when we come after them.
sentences.zh: 我们不能接受任何让共和党人在我们对他们发起进攻时能够混淆视听的违纪行为。

sentences.en: I remember, Jonathan, as I'm sure you do, that some people saw Franken as a kind of sacrificial lamb for the Democratic Party to pursue this strategy you're describing.
sentences.zh: 我记得，乔纳森，就像你肯定也记得的那样，有些人把弗兰肯视为民主党推行你所描述的这种策略的某种“替罪羊”。

sentences.en: And I wonder if as a political reporter in that moment, you sensed what the conversation was among Democratic politicians and strategists about this decision the party had made.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，作为当时的政治记者，你是否能感受到民主党政客和战略家们对党内做出的这个决定是如何讨论的？

sentences.en: It's a question that privately, plenty of Democrats were saying that Franken is basically walking the plank because we have to make this point and we have to be pure on this issue.
sentences.zh: 私下里，很多民主党人都在说，弗兰肯基本上是在走钢丝，因为我们必须表明这个立场，我们在这个问题上必须保持纯洁。

sentences.en: Now, they wouldn't dare say that publicly, but keep in mind, the backbone of the Democratic Party in this era is women.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们不敢公开这样说，但请记住，这个时代的民主党人的基石是女性。

sentences.en: They are crucial to Democrats winning elections.
sentences.zh: 她们对民主党赢得选举至关重要。

sentences.en: And I think that the party felt like they didn't have a choice when it came to Franken in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为党内在那个时刻觉得在弗兰肯这件事上他们别无选择。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So zero tolerance can seem hard line, but it allows the Democrats to call out the Republicans without any room for accusations of being hypocritical.
sentences.zh: 所以零容忍看起来可能很强硬，但它让民主党人能够质问共和党人，而不会留下任何被指责为虚伪的余地。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 就是这个意思。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how did this Democratic strategy of zero tolerance actually play out after Franken was forced to resign?
sentences.zh: 在弗兰肯被迫辞职后，民主党这种零容忍策略实际效果如何？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think the Franken precedent is what has for some time now carried the day for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为弗兰肯的先例是一段时间以来民主党一直遵循的准则。

sentences.en: You had other accusations of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 你还遇到了其他性行为不端的指控。

sentences.en: The dean of the House of Representatives, its longest serving member, stepped down today under pressure.
sentences.zh: 众议院资历最深、任职时间最长的资深议员今天在压力下辞职了。

sentences.en: Democrat John Conyers was accused of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 民主党人约翰·康yers被指控性行为不端。

sentences.en: John Conyers, longtime member of Congress from Michigan.
sentences.zh: 约翰·康yers，来自密歇根州的长期国会议员。

sentences.en: You had an up and coming Democrat in the House from Nevada who also was similarly forced out because of fairly serious sexual harassment charges.
sentences.zh: 你还有一位来自内华达州的众议院新晋民主党人，他也因为相当严重的性骚扰指控而同样被迫下台。

sentences.en: That has become the kind of Democrats rule of thumb that we're going to take a sort of zero tolerance approach on these kinds of allegations.
sentences.zh: 这已经成为民主党人的某种经验法则，即对这类指控采取某种零容忍的态度。

sentences.en: We need one standard across the board.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个全党统一的标准。

sentences.en: So if folks are we're going to call on Donald Trump to resign, John Conyers, who has retired or resigned, if folks are going to call on everybody else to resign,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果人们要求唐纳德·特朗普辞职，要求已经退休或辞职的约翰·康yers辞职，如果人们要求其他所有人辞职，

sentences.en: then we have to hold Senator Franken and anyone else that is accused of sexual assault to resign.
sentences.zh: 那么我们也必须让参议员弗兰肯以及任何其他被指控性侵的人辞职。

sentences.en: And I think that is what really set the predicate going into the Brett Kavanaugh hearings.
sentences.zh: 我认为这才是真正为布雷特·卡瓦诺听证会奠定基础的前提。

sentences.en: Democrats, once they found out that he had been accused of sexual assault, a lot of them felt like this is somebody who simply cannot sit on the highest court in the land.
sentences.zh: 民主党人一旦发现他被指控性侵，许多人就觉得这个人简直不能坐在国家最高法院的位置上。

sentences.en: And for them, it was the very principle of, you know, do we believe women?
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这触及了一个根本原则，你知道的，就是我们是否相信女性？

sentences.en: I believe you.
sentences.zh: 我相信你。

sentences.en: And I believe many Americans across this country believe you.
sentences.zh: 我相信全国各地的许多美国人都相信你。

sentences.en: That's the guiding force in terms of the Democratic strategy on this.
sentences.zh: 这是民主党在这方面战略的指导力量。

sentences.en: So, you know, we come down on the side of the accuser.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们站在指控者这一边。

sentences.en: We believe women.
sentences.zh: 我们相信女性。

sentences.en: This man is not a monster, nor is he what has been represented here in these hearings.
sentences.zh: 这个人不是恶魔，也不是这些听证会上所描绘的那样。

sentences.en: But the Republicans and what was really a sign of a divided country sided largely with Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 但共和党人——这真正标志着一个分裂国家的现实——很大程度上站在了卡瓦诺一边。

sentences.en: And I think there was no more illustrative moment of this country's chasm on these issues than those Supreme Court hearings last year.
sentences.zh: 我认为，没有任何时刻比去年那场最高法院听证会更能说明这个国家在这些问题上的巨大鸿沟了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it also, to me, started to signal some of the potential limitations of zero tolerance,
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，这也开始显现出零容忍政策的一些潜在局限性，

sentences.en: which is that some Americans started to look around them at the people they know or at themselves and to ask,
sentences.zh: 那就是一些美国人开始环顾四周，看看他们认识的人或他们自己，并开始发问：

sentences.en: would I want to be held to this zero tolerance standard that the Democrats are holding people to right now?
sentences.zh: 我愿意让自己受到民主党人目前用来要求别人的这种零容忍标准的约束吗？

sentences.en: Yes, because what happened with the Kavanaugh hearings was also this question of, well, how far back do we go?
sentences.zh: 是的，因为卡瓦诺听证会发生的事情同时也引发了这样一个问题：好吧，我们要追溯到多久以前？

sentences.en: And are we going to start judging people based on their high school and college conduct?
sentences.zh: 我们是要开始根据人们在高中和大学时的行为来评判他们吗？

sentences.en: And that was a huge thread of that moment.
sentences.zh: 那是当时的一个核心议题。

sentences.en: And I think that a lot of conservative women especially looked at somebody like Kavanaugh and said, that could be my husband.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多保守派女性尤其看着像卡瓦诺这样的人，心想：那可能会是我的丈夫。

sentences.en: That could be my son who could be, in their eyes, falsely accused.
sentences.zh: 那可能会是我的儿子，在她们眼里，他们可能会被虚假指控。

sentences.en: And a lot of other people looked at Blasey Ford and said, heck, that could be my daughter or my wife.
sentences.zh: 而许多其他人看着布拉齐·福特则心想：天哪，那可能会是我的女儿或我的妻子。

sentences.en: And I sure as heck would want them to be believed.
sentences.zh: 我当然希望她们能被相信。

sentences.en: So it did start this moment of a conversation of, OK, well, what is and is not fair game and what is that line?
sentences.zh: 因此，这确实引发了这样一场对话：好吧，什么才是合理的范围，什么又不是？那条线到底在哪里？

sentences.en: We still haven't sort of defined that.
sentences.zh: 我们至今还没有明确定义这一点。

sentences.en: It's still a kind of moving target here.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个不断移动的目标。

sentences.en: But quietly, you do hear some Democrats starting to wonder, well, how far is this going to go?
sentences.zh: 但私下里，你确实听到一些民主党人开始嘀咕：好吧，这到底要持续到什么时候？

sentences.en: And Virginia has really brought that question home.
sentences.zh: 而弗吉尼亚州的事件真正把这个问题摆到了台面上。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请今天就下载《时报》应用，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So let's just start, Jonathan, by reviewing what's actually happened in Virginia over the past week.
sentences.zh: 那么，乔纳森，让我们先来回顾一下过去一周在弗吉尼亚州实际发生了什么。

sentences.en: Deep breath.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's been an extraordinary week in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州经历了非同寻常的一周。

sentences.en: Nobody in the Capitol here has seen anything like this in state history.
sentences.zh: 这里国会山的任何人在州历史上都从未见过这样的情景。

sentences.en: It started on Friday.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于星期五。

sentences.en: Breaking tonight, a racist yearbook photo taken over three decades ago has surfaced, leaving Virginia's Democratic governor facing some serious questions about his paSt.
sentences.zh: 今晚突发新闻：一张拍摄于三十多年前的种族主义年鉴照片浮出水面，让弗吉尼亚州民主党州长面临关于其过去的严重质疑。

sentences.en: A conservative website published a yearbook photo from Governor Ralph Northam's medical school from 1984.
sentences.zh: 一家保守派网站公布了州长拉爾夫·诺瑟姆1984年医学院时期的年鉴照片。

sentences.en: A decades-old yearbook page suddenly in the spotlight tonight because of this picture of two people, one in blackface, the other in a KKK hood.
sentences.zh: 一张几十年前的年鉴页面今晚突然成为聚光灯下的焦点，因为这张照片上有两个人，一人涂着黑脸妆，另一人戴着三K党头套。

sentences.en: This immediately created a firestorm.
sentences.zh: 这立即引发了一场风暴。

sentences.en: He was either the guy in the Klan outfit or in blackface when he was an adult in medical school.
sentences.zh: 当他在医学院作为一个成年人时，他要么是穿着三K党服装的那个人，要么是画着黑脸妆的那个人。

sentences.en: This is not some youthful indiscretion.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么年轻时的轻率行为。

sentences.en: This is an adult acting as a raciSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一个成年人在表现得像个种族主义者。

sentences.en: And by Friday night, Governor Northam had conceded and apologized for being on that page and asked for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 到周五晚上，诺瑟姆州长已经承认并为自己出现在那一页上进行了道歉，并请求原谅。

sentences.en: I cannot change the decisions I made, nor can I undo the harm my behavior caused then and today.
sentences.zh: 我无法改变我做过的决定，也无法抹杀我的行为在当时和今天造成的伤害。

sentences.en: But I accept responsibility for my past actions, and I am ready to do the hard work of regaining your truSt.
sentences.zh: 但我为我过去的行动承担责任，我准备好付出艰苦的努力来重新赢得你们的信任。

sentences.en: Well, by midnight, Democrats across the country and in Virginia were demanding he resign.
sentences.zh: 好吧，到了午夜，全国各地以及弗吉尼亚州的民主党人都在要求他辞职。

sentences.en: Reaction across the political spectrum pouring in tonight after Governor Ralph Northam admits and apologizes
sentences.zh: 在拉尔夫·诺瑟姆州长承认并道歉之后，今晚来自整个政治光谱的反应如潮水般涌来

sentences.en: for appearing at a racist photo that dates back to his med school days in 1984.
sentences.zh: 因为他出现在一张可追溯到1984年他医学院时期的种族主义照片中。

sentences.en: On Saturday, Governor Northam reversed course, had a news conference at the executive mansion in Richmond.
sentences.zh: 周六，诺瑟姆州长态度逆转，在里士满的行政官邸举行了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: In the hours since I made my statement yesterday, I reflected with my family and classmates from the time and affirmed my conclusion that I am not the person in that photo.
sentences.zh: 在我昨天发表声明以来的几个小时里，我和我的家人以及当年的同班同学进行了反思，并确信我不是那张照片里的人。

sentences.en: He had concluded that he was not one of the two men in that photograph and that he had no plans to resign.
sentences.zh: 他得出结论，自己并不是那张照片里的两个人之一，也没有辞职的打算。

sentences.en: I did participate in a dance contest in San Antonio in which I darkened my face as part of a Michael Jackson costume.
sentences.zh: 我确实参加过圣安东尼奥的一场舞蹈比赛，当时为了扮成迈克尔·杰克逊，我把脸涂黑了。

sentences.en: It is because my memory of that episode is so vivid that I truly do not believe I am in the picture in my yearbook.
sentences.zh: 正因为我对那段经历的记忆如此清晰，我才坚信自己没有出现在毕业纪念册的照片里。

sentences.en: Then Sunday, Super Bowl Sunday, there is rumors swirling all day that the lieutenant governor, Justin Fairfax, has some kind of a Me Too issue with it.
sentences.zh: 然后到了周日，也就是超级碗星期天，整天都有传言称副州长贾斯汀·费尔法克斯卷入了某种类似“我也是”运动的丑闻。

sentences.en: It's not clear what it is.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚具体是什么情况。

sentences.en: Now, Justin Fairfax himself stands accused of serious wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 现在，贾斯汀·费尔法克斯本人面临着严重不当行为的指控。

sentences.en: At 3 in the morning on Sunday night, so Monday morning, Fairfax, lieutenant governor,
sentences.zh: 在周日深夜凌晨3点，也就是周一早晨，副州长费尔法克斯

sentences.en: posts a statement on his Twitter account preemptively saying that he did not commit sexual assault on a woman.
sentences.zh: 在推特账户上发表了一份声明，抢先声称他没有对一名女性实施性侵。

sentences.en: Monday morning, The Washington Post publishes a story saying, we reported this out last year around the time that Fairfax was being inaugurated,
sentences.zh: 周一上午，《华盛顿邮报》发表了一篇报道称，我们在去年费尔法克斯就职前后就着手调查此事了，

sentences.en: and we decided that we couldn't corroborate it and we were not going to publish it.
sentences.zh: 当时我们认为无法证实，所以决定不予发表。

sentences.en: But they did, at that point, offer some details about the woman and about the encounter.
sentences.zh: 但在那个时候，他们确实透露了一些关于这位女性以及那次相遇的细节。

sentences.en: A politics professor from California called Vanessa Tyson says that Fairfax sexually assaulted her in his hotel room at the 2004 Democratic National Convention in Boston.
sentences.zh: 来自加利福尼亚的一名政治学教授瓦妮萨·泰森称，费尔法克斯在2004年波士顿民主党全国代表大会期间的酒店房间里对她进行了性侵。

sentences.en: Fairfax emphatically denies again the case, And at that point, start suggesting that some of his political rivals are potentially behind the leak.
sentences.zh: 费尔法克斯再次坚决否认这一指控，并在当时暗示，他的一些政治对手可能在幕后操纵了这次泄密。

sentences.en: You don't have to be a political genius to understand that this is a complete smear.
sentences.zh: 你不需要是个政治天才，也能看出这是一场彻头彻尾的诽谤。

sentences.en: And in my character, I've put up four elections for the people of the Commonwealth of Virginia in three statewide elections.
sentences.zh: 在我的政治生涯中，我为弗吉尼亚联邦的人民参加过四次选举，其中包括三次全州范围的选举。

sentences.en: Never has anything like this ever been raised, not throughout my life.
sentences.zh: 从来没有发生过类似的事情，我的一生中都没有。

sentences.en: Flash forward then to Wednesday, where the state's leadership is already in chaos.
sentences.zh: 快进到周三，当时州的领导层已经陷入混乱。

sentences.en: People are waiting to hear what they're going to do.
sentences.zh: 人们都在等待他们的决定。

sentences.en: Will they resign?
sentences.zh: 他们会辞职吗？

sentences.en: And rumors again pick up.
sentences.zh: 各种传言再次甚嚣尘上。

sentences.en: Now to another update in the now multiple scandals embroiling Virginia's top officials.
sentences.zh: 现在来看卷入弗吉尼亚高官的多起丑闻的又一个最新进展。

sentences.en: This time that Mark Herring, the attorney general, has some kind of racially insensitive issue in his paSt.
sentences.zh: 这一次是总检察长马克·赫林，他的过去卷入了某种涉及种族敏感的问题。

sentences.en: A stunning admission from Virginia's attorney general, Mark Herring, who revealed he once wore blackface in college.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州总检察长马克·赫林作出惊人坦白，他透露自己上大学时曾把脸涂黑扮成黑人。

sentences.en: He said he was dressed as a rapper in the style of the legendary Curtis Blow.
sentences.zh: 他说自己当时打扮成传奇说唱歌手柯蒂斯·布劳的风格。

sentences.en: This comes after Herring, called that photograph on Northam's medical school yearbook page, indefensible, profoundly offensive, shocking, and deeply disappointing.
sentences.zh: 此前，赫林曾称诺瑟姆医学院年鉴页面上的那张照片是“不可辩护的”、“极其冒犯的”、“令人震惊的”和“深感失望的”。

sentences.en: And that leads us to Wednesday, where the state of Virginia is in utter chaos.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了周三，当时弗吉尼亚州陷入了一片混乱。

sentences.en: It's not clear who is still going to be in power by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚到本周末谁还能继续掌权。

sentences.en: And so obviously this presents a kind of overwhelming stress test, I have to imagine, on the Democrats' zero tolerance policy.
sentences.zh: 很显然，我想象这给民主党的零容忍政策带来了一种压倒性的压力测试。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Now, you know, this is where the rubber meets the road.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道，这是动真格的时候了。

sentences.en: Are Democrats going to enforce their own policies in this moment where you've got three Democrats who lead a major state in this country
sentences.zh: 民主党人会在这个时候强制执行他们自己的政策吗？现在这个国家一个大州有三位民主党领导人

sentences.en: who are facing serious allegations of racist conduct and sexual assault?
sentences.zh: 正面临着种族主义行为和性侵犯的严重指控？

sentences.en: Are they going to force all three out?
sentences.zh: 他们会迫使这三个人全部下台吗？

sentences.en: Are they going to show forgiveness for some but not others?
sentences.zh: 他们会对某些人网开一面，而对其他人不予原谅吗？

sentences.en: Are they going to show forgiveness for all three?
sentences.zh: 还是会对这三个人全部网开一面？

sentences.en: Well, walk us through how Democrats are handling it so far and what they have been thinking.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲民主党人目前是如何处理这件事的，以及他们一直在考虑什么。

sentences.en: So, so far, the hardest line has been on Northam.
sentences.zh: 所以，到目前为止，立场最坚定的是针对诺瑟姆。

sentences.en: Tonight, the calls for Governor Ralph Northam to resign are growing.
sentences.zh: 今晚，要求拉尔夫·诺瑟姆州长辞职的呼声越来越高。

sentences.en: Reaction was swift, with much of the outrage coming from Northam's fellow Democrats.
sentences.zh: 各方的反应迅速，大部分的愤怒来自于诺瑟姆的民主党同僚。

sentences.en: State legislators, the Virginia State Black Caucus, for example, presidential candidates Kamala Harris, Kirsten Gillibrand, Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 例如州议员、弗吉尼亚州黑人核心会议，还有总统候选人卡玛拉·哈里斯、基尔斯滕·吉利布兰德、伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: Joe Biden, Hillary Clinton, Obama, Attorney General Eric Holder,
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登、希拉里·克林顿、奥巴马、总检察长埃里克·霍尔德，

sentences.en: Bernie Sanders, Cory Booker, Eric Swalwell.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯、科里·布克、埃里克·斯瓦韦尔。

sentences.en: Practically every major Democrat has called on Northam to resign.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有主要的民主党人都要求诺瑟姆辞职。

sentences.en: So Democrats are largely united on that front.
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人在这一阵线上基本保持一致。

sentences.en: With Fairfax, there's much more of a wait-and-see mode.
sentences.zh: 对于费尔法克斯，大家更多地采取了观望态度。

sentences.en: Here we go again, except for now, you know, you have Democrats who are avoiding talking to the press.
sentences.zh: 历史总是惊人地相似，只不过现在，你知道的，有些民主党人开始避免接受记者采访了。

sentences.en: It's difficult because you've got a woman making detailed accusations now on the record.
sentences.zh: 这很艰难，因为现在有一位女性在公开记录中做出了详细的指控。

sentences.en: Fairfax emphatically denies it.
sentences.zh: 费尔法克斯对此坚决否认。

sentences.en: Neither of them have yet to produce corroborating evidence from that time.
sentences.zh: 他们两人目前都还没有拿出当时能够佐证的证据。

sentences.en: So Democrats on that situation are saying...
sentences.zh: 所以在那种情况下，民主党人表示……

sentences.en: I think it's important to have consistency and moral clarity.
sentences.zh: 我认为保持一致性和道德清晰度是很重要的。

sentences.en: I don't have any reason to know whether Justin Fairfax is telling the truth or not.
sentences.zh: 我没有理由知道贾斯汀·费尔法克斯说的是不是实话。

sentences.en: But I think I'd say the same thing I said in the Brett Kavanaugh issue, which is there should be a full and complete, thorough, independent investigation.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我会说出我在布雷特·卡瓦诺事件中所说的话，那就是应该进行一次全面、彻底、独立的调查。

sentences.en: They want to hear more.
sentences.zh: 他们想要了解更多情况。

sentences.en: They want to see an investigation even.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至希望看到一项调查。

sentences.en: That's a tough situation because what happens if there is no investigation?
sentences.zh: 这是一个棘手的局面，因为如果没有调查会怎么样？

sentences.en: What happens if it does just remain the accusations of Ms. Tyson and the denial of Mr. Fairfax?
sentences.zh: 如果事情依然只是泰森女士的指控和费尔法克斯先生的否认，那该怎么办？

sentences.en: What do they do?
sentences.zh: 他们会怎么做？

sentences.en: And does Mark Herring need to go?
sentences.zh: 马克·赫林需要离职吗？

sentences.en: Are there calls for him to go?
sentences.zh: 有人要求他离职吗？

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 现在情况怎么样？

sentences.en: So no calls on Herring to go yet.
sentences.zh: 所以目前还没有人要求赫林离职。

sentences.en: With the case of Herring, he preemptively apologized to the Black Caucus, an emotional meeting Wednesday morning in Richmond.
sentences.zh: 就赫林而言，他在周三上午里士满的一次情感激动的会议上，提前向黑人核心会议作出了道歉。

sentences.en: He seems to be on somewhat steadier ground because of how he handled the issue.
sentences.zh: 由于他处理问题的方式，他的立场似乎显得稍微稳固了一些。

sentences.en: Also worth noting, yes, there is politics in the politics.
sentences.zh: 同样值得注意的是，政治背后的确存在政治博弈。

sentences.en: Here's the law.
sentences.zh: 法律规定如下。

sentences.en: If the attorney general of Virginia is to resign during the legislative session, his successor would be picked by the legislature.
sentences.zh: 如果弗吉尼亚州总检察长在立法会议期间辞职，他的继任者将由立法机构选出。

sentences.en: Well, guess what?
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: The Republicans control narrowly the state house and state senate.
sentences.zh: 共和党人微弱地控制着州众议院和州参议院。

sentences.en: So they would be in charge of picking a successor if Herring does resign.
sentences.zh: 所以如果赫林真的辞职，他们将负责挑选继任者。

sentences.en: So that also has created some incentive for Democrats to hold their fire.
sentences.zh: 因此，这也促使民主党人选择暂时按兵不动。

sentences.en: So suddenly zero tolerance in the midst of a very confusing situation is being even more further complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以在这样一个令人困惑的局势中，零容忍政策突然变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: By politics.
sentences.zh: 夹杂了政治因素。

sentences.en: It's important to keep in mind, Michael, if I can just go back for a minute to what happened in the case of Al Franken and in the case of John Conyers.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，请记住这一点，如果我能回到一分钟前阿尔·弗兰肯和约翰·康耶斯身上发生的事情的话。

sentences.en: There was no real political risk there because you had Democrats in Minnesota who were going to replace Franken with a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 那里没有真正的政治风险，因为明尼苏达州的民主党人会用另一个民主党人来取代弗兰肯。

sentences.en: And John Conyers had a really safe seat in Detroit and he was going to be replaced by a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 而约翰·康耶斯在底特律拥有一个非常稳固的席位，他也将由一名民主党人接替。

sentences.en: No real risk there.
sentences.zh: 那里没有什么真正的风险。

sentences.en: It's a different story, I think, in Virginia, where you've got all 140 seats of the state legislature up for grabs this fall.
sentences.zh: 我想在弗吉尼亚情况就完全不同了，今年秋天州议会的所有140个席位都将面临争夺。

sentences.en: Democrats are on the threshold of taking back both chambers, which would give them entire domination of state politics.
sentences.zh: 民主党人正处于夺回两院控制权的边缘，这将赋予他们对州政治的全面统治权。

sentences.en: And, you know, do you want to hand the Republicans the attorney general's seat entirely by forcing him to resign
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，难道你想通过迫使他辞职，

sentences.en: and letting the Republican-controlled legislature appoint his successor?
sentences.zh: 并让共和党控制的立法机构任命他的继任者，从而把总检察长的席位拱手让给共和党吗？

sentences.en: You know, that's a much more real, shall we say, test of this policy than it was with the Franken or Conyers situation
sentences.zh: 你知道，比起弗兰肯或康耶斯的状况，这才是对这项政策更真实、可以说是更严峻的考验，

sentences.en: because you're talking about much more in the way of political sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 因为你谈论的是更多政治上的牺牲。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I wonder, is your sense, Jonathan, that the bigger question here is about that, whether Democrats are willing to stand by this policy
sentences.zh: 但我想知道，乔纳森，你的直觉是，这里更大的问题在于此——民主党人是否愿意坚守这项政策，

sentences.en: when it could have negative political implications, like a Republican taking a democratically held seat, or that it's about perhaps this zero-tolerance policy
sentences.zh: 当它可能带来负面政治影响时，比如让共和党人夺走原本由民主党掌控的席位；还是说，是因为这项零容忍政策

sentences.en: being too stringent for the reality of our lives?
sentences.zh: 对于我们生活的现实来说过于严苛了？

sentences.en: Yeah, there's two things at work here in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 是的，在弗吉尼亚这里有两个因素在起作用。

sentences.en: As more and more revelations come out of college students appearing in blackface and yearbooks, I think this question now is,
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的大学生涂黑脸扮成黑人的照片从年鉴中被曝光，我认为现在的问题是，

sentences.en: how many people are going to get swept up in this kind of investigation?
sentences.zh: 有多少人会被卷入这种调查之中？

sentences.en: And if we do apply this standard widely, that that is abhorrent behavior that has to be prosecuted with the loss of a job,
sentences.zh: 如果我们广泛推行这一标准，即这种令人厌恶的行为必须以失去工作来进行惩处，

sentences.en: then are we prepared for a lot of people to lose their jobs?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是否准备好让许多人失去工作？

sentences.en: Some people will say, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 有些人会说，当然准备好了。

sentences.en: It is an appalling demonstration of racism.
sentences.zh: 这是对种族主义令人发指的展示。

sentences.en: It's the worst kind of a vestige of the bad old days.
sentences.zh: 这是那段黑暗过去最糟糕的残余。

sentences.en: And we absolutely should penalize folks for that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对应该为此惩罚人们。

sentences.en: There are others who will say it took place 30 years ago.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则会说，那是30年前发生的事情。

sentences.en: People make mistakes in their youth.
sentences.zh: 人在年轻时都会犯错。

sentences.en: They shouldn't lose their jobs and their livelihoods for their worst day or their worst moment.
sentences.zh: 他们不应该因为最糟糕的一天或最糟糕的时刻而失去工作和生计。

sentences.en: You're going to hear both of those arguments quite a bit in the days ahead because these pictures of blackface are not going to be limited to a few politicians in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的日子里，你会听到很多这两种论点，因为这些涂黑脸的照片不会局限于弗吉尼亚州的少数几位政客。

sentences.en: You can be assured that this is going to be turning up in other states and other professions around the country.
sentences.zh: 你可以确信，这将在全国其他州和其它行业中不断涌现。

sentences.en: And it's not going to stop here.
sentences.zh: 而且它不会在这里停止。

sentences.en: It's going to be a bigger conversation beyond this state and beyond politics.
sentences.zh: 这将成为超越这个州、超越政治的更大范围的讨论。

sentences.en: Jonathan, we started by talking about Al Franken and the line that was drawn in his case as Democrats started to create this zero tolerance policy 18 months ago.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，我们一开始谈论的是阿尔·弗兰肯，以及18个月前民主党人开始制定这一零容忍政策时划在他身上的红线。

sentences.en: I wonder if in this moment Democrats are recalibrating and rethinking that decision to force him to resign given the recalibration we're seeing now.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，鉴于我们现在看到的重新评估，此时此刻民主党人是否在重新评估并反思当初迫使他辞职的决定。

sentences.en: I think we're seeing the first makings of that recalibration.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们正在看到这种重新评估的最初迹象。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if they'll go fully through with rethinking their policy as long as Trump is the president and they want to have the high ground.
sentences.zh: 我不确定只要特朗普还是总统，他们想占据道德制高点，他们就会彻底重新考虑自己的政策。

sentences.en: But the best example of this kind of real-time assessment is Senator Gillibrand who led the charge when it came to pushing out Al Franken
sentences.zh: 但这种实时评估的最好例子就是吉利布兰德参议员，她在推动阿尔·弗兰肯下台时曾带头冲锋，

sentences.en: but who has said on Fairfax that she wants to see an investigation.
sentences.zh: 但对于费尔法克斯，她却表示希望看到一项调查。

sentences.en: She was very sympathetic to the woman, Dr. Tyson, and the charges that Dr. Tyson made.
sentences.zh: 她对泰森博士这位女性以及泰森博士提出的指控非常同情。

sentences.en: But Senator Gillibrand's not calling for Fairfax to resign.
sentences.zh: 但吉利布兰德参议员并未呼吁费尔法克斯辞职。

sentences.en: She's saying that she wants to hear or see rather an investigation of this case.
sentences.zh: 她说她希望听到或者更确切地说看到对这起案件的调查。

sentences.en: That itself is very telling.
sentences.zh: 这本身就说明了很多问题。

sentences.en: The fact that Gillibrand has been out front on these issues is not calling for Fairfax to quit.
sentences.zh: 吉利布兰德在这些问题上一直冲在前面，却唯独没有呼吁费尔法克斯辞职的事实。

sentences.en: She's calling for an investigation.
sentences.zh: 她呼吁的是进行调查。

sentences.en: I think does indicate the first makings of some kind of recalibration on this approach.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实表明了对这种做法进行某种重新评估的最初迹象。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you very, very much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Bill.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，比尔。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: On Thursday, yet another elected official in Virginia, this time a Republican, became ensnared in the state's political crisis.
sentences.zh: 周四，弗吉尼亚州的又一位民选官员，这次是一名共和党人，也被卷入了该州的政治危机之中。

sentences.en: State Senate Majority Leader Thomas Norman acknowledged his role in editing a yearbook that featured racist slurs against African Americans, Asians, and Jews,
sentences.zh: 州参议院多数党领袖托马斯·诺曼承认自己参与编辑了一本年鉴，其中包含针对非裔、亚裔和犹太人的种族主义侮辱，

sentences.en: as well as racist photographs, including people in blackface.
sentences.zh: 以及种族主义照片，包括人们涂黑脸的画面。

sentences.en: I don't condone it, and I haven't engaged in it.
sentences.zh: 我不宽恕这种行为，也没有参与其中。

sentences.en: If you look back through that yearbook, you will see, first of all, I do not appear in any pictures in any derogatory or disingenuous way to any minority group.
sentences.zh: 如果你翻看那本年鉴，你会发现，首先，我没有出现在任何对任何少数群体带有贬损或虚伪意味的照片中。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Supreme Court voted to block a Louisiana law that would have made it harder to have abortions in the state in a 5-4 decision that suggests, for now,
sentences.zh: 周四，最高法院以5比4的投票结果阻止了一项路易斯安那州的法律，该法原本会使在该州实施堕胎变得更加困难，这一决定表明，目前

sentences.en: that the court will observe precedent on the issue despite its rightward tilt under President Trump.
sentences.zh: 尽管最高法院在特朗普总统任下向右倾斜，但它仍将遵循该问题的先例。

sentences.en: The decision, in which Chief Justice John Roberts sided with the court's liberal members, prevents Louisiana from enforcing a law
sentences.zh: 这项由首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨站在法院自由派成员一边的裁决，阻止了路易斯安那州执行一项法律，

sentences.en: that opponents said would close most of the state's abortion clinics.
sentences.zh: 反对者称该法将关闭该州大多数堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: During today's hearing, we will examine a topic of great interest to the American people.
sentences.zh: 在今天的听证会上，我们将探讨一个美国人民高度关注的话题。

sentences.en: We will reveal whether a president,
sentences.zh: 我们将揭晓总统、

sentences.en: vice president,
sentences.zh: 副总统、

sentences.en: or any candidate for this office should be required by law to make their tax return available to the public.
sentences.zh: 或该职位的任何候选人是否应被法律要求向公众公开其纳税申报表。

sentences.en: House Democrats began hearings on Thursday about a plan that would force President Trump to release his tax returns, despite his longstanding objections to making them public.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人于周四开始就一项计划举行听证会，该计划将迫使特朗普总统公布他的纳税申报表，尽管他长期以来一直反对将其公开。

sentences.en: In other words, we were asked the question,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我们被问到一个问题，

sentences.en: does the public have a need to know that a person seeking or holding the highest office in our country obeys the tax laws?
sentences.zh: 公众是否有必要知道一个寻求或担任我们国家最高职务的人是否遵守了税收法律？

sentences.en: The House Ways and Means Committee debated a bill that would compel presidential candidates, including Trump, to release 10 years of tax returns
sentences.zh: 众议院筹款委员会辩论了一项法案，该法案将强制包括特朗普在内的总统候选人在获得党内提名后不久，

sentences.en: shortly after receiving their party's nomination.
sentences.zh: 公布其10年的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: But Republicans on the committee, including Representative Mike Kelly, warned against trying to release the president's tax returns against his will.
sentences.zh: 但委员会中的共和党人，包括众议员迈克·凯利，警告不要试图违背总统意愿公开其纳税申报表。

sentences.en: It would set a very dangerous precedent.
sentences.zh: 这将开创一个非常危险的先例。

sentences.en: And the question is, where does it end?
sentences.zh: 问题是，这何时才是个尽头？

sentences.en: What about the tax returns of the Speaker, members of Congress, or federal employees, or for that matter, any political donors?
sentences.zh: 众议院议长、国会成员、联邦员工，或者干脆说任何政治捐款人的纳税申报表又该怎么算？

sentences.en: There is no end in sight for those whose tax information may be in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 对于那些税务信息可能面临风险的人来说，这简直遥遥无期、永无止境。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
